flashSizeHint: Pick the flash size that matches your board - see the chart above for which chip families use each size.
layoutHint: Pick the board matching your HUB75 setup - see the chart above for the chip and flash size it needs.
memoryTypeHint: Only matters if your board has PSRAM - pick the option matching its interface. Leave on Standard if unsure or your board has none.
flashModeHint: Default matches the flash mode this release's standard build already uses for each chip - safest choice, and required to match an existing bootloader when updating in place. DIO/QIO force that mode where a matching release build exists - see the chart above for which chip(s) that currently applies to.
